description: This file contains the definition of the StandardUrlLocationResolver class which implements the LocationResolver interface. It provides functionality to resolve a String location into a URL object, using the UtilURL utility class.

classes.name: StandardUrlLocationResolver
classes.description: A resolver class for converting String locations into URL objects, implementing the LocationResolver interface.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Converts a String location into a URL object using UtilURL's fromUrlString method.
